featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Ranjan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Warning: Do Not Rely on This Ambulance Service in Critical Situations

I’m sharing this with the hope that no one else has to go through what I did.

My wife was in a critical condition, admitted to the ICU at Apex Hospital, Kandivali East. The hospital had a tie-up with ambulance care ambulance service, and unfortunately, both the hospital and the ambulance team proved to be shockingly unprofessional.

Initially, I requested a transfer to a nearby, better-equipped hospital. The ICU team agreed and called the ambulance. However, as my wife's condition worsened, I made the decision to shift her to Kokilaben Hospital in Andheri West—a far more advanced facility. What followed was deeply distressing.

- Misguidance & Fear-Mongering:
Both the ICU doctor and the ambulance doctor, Dr. Dhirendra Dwiwedi, tried to dissuade me from transferring her to Kokilaben, citing distance and time constraints. This was misleading—it was an intra-city transfer, not an inter-city one.

- Deliberate Delay:
After I insisted firmly on taking the risk, the ambulance doctor made me wait an additional 10 minutes just to write a handwritten disclaimer stating they wouldn’t be responsible for any mishaps. In a moment where every second mattered, this delay was inexcusable.

- Unprepared & Unprofessional:
Shockingly, the ambulance didn’t even have enough diesel. We had to stop at a petrol pump mid-transfer while my wife was on ventilator support. This level of negligence is beyond comprehension.

- Unjustified Charges:
The final bill was ₹7,500—despite the earlier agreed amount of ₹4,500 for a transfer to Kandivali West. The extra ₹3,000 for a slightly longer route within Mumbai was never explained transparently. When I raised this with the owner, he argued that the change in destination required refueling. That’s their excuse for wasting precious time during a life-threatening emergency.

This experience was not just disappointing—it was dangerous. In moments where professionalism, preparedness, and urgency are non-negotiable, this team failed on every front.

Please, do not trust this ambulance service in emergencies. Your loved one’s life may depend on it.
